Example medical devices and non-device clinical products

device_test_set.Rd

A curated benchmark dataset of 50 product names covering EU/UK MDR classes (Class I to Class III), IVDR classes (IVD (Class A) to IVD (Class D)), 18 clinical specialities, common NHS dm+d non-device items (such as emollient creams, pharmaceuticals, and nutritional feeds), and a whitespace duplicate.

Usage

device_test_set

Format

A tibble with 50 rows and 7 columns:

device_id

Integer row identifier.

device_name

Character product name to classify.

expected_is_device

Character reference label ("yes" or "no").

expected_class

Character reference EU/UK MDR or IVDR risk class, or NA for non-devices.

expected_speciality

Character reference clinical speciality, or NA for non-devices.

expected_is_implantable

Character reference implantable flag ("yes", "no", or NA for non-devices).

expected_is_active

Character reference active-device flag ("yes", "no", or NA for non-devices).

Source

Curated synthetic examples based on EU/UK MDR, IVDR, and NHS dm+d product naming conventions.
